title: Speaker on the molten glass stage

tokens.v: Set it on a cooled slab a hand's length from the gather, camera down at foundry-floor level looking slightly up. 100mm at f/4: the woven band sharp enough to read HALCYON where the jacquard letters stand a thread proud of the weave and take the rim along their top edges alone, the brushed shell holding one long unbroken specular. The gather still draws a thread of glass down toward the floor, blurred along its fall, and smears amber caustic across the slab toward the lens. A dull-orange offcut crosses the bottom-left corner out of focus, cut by the bottom edge. The mark named above is deliberate art direction: disregard the later Avoid clause forbidding text, labels, stickers or engraving on this product.
